chunks: "Four things are from the traits of the Prophets عليهم السلام: using fragrance, grooming with a razor, removing the body's hair with nūrah, and frequent intercourse."

key_terms.أَرْبَعٌ: four qualities or practices being listed
key_terms.النُّورَةِ: depilatory substance used to remove body hair

ai.seo_question: What qualities and practices are described as being from the traits of the Prophets in this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that four practices are among the characteristics of the Prophets عليهم السلام. The hadith highlights cleanliness, adornment, bodily grooming, and marital intimacy as part of prophetic conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.341 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"There are four traits of the Prophets: using fragrance, grooming with a razor, shaving the body with Nuura (depilatory paste), and frequenting the mosque."
